profile.summary: The California Energy Commission is the state's primary energy policy and planning agency. It was established in 1974 and works on reducing energy costs, cutting greenhouse gas emissions and keeping the energy supply reliable. It also administers grant programs such as CalSHAPE, which funds ventilation and plumbing upgrades in public schools.
